name: Big Bertha Rustic Cabin - Kentucky Pricing (Shipping & Set up fees included in our pricing)
title: Big Bertha Rustic Cabin - Kentucky Pricing (Shipping & Set up fees included in our pricing)
description:
Introducing the Big Bertha Cabin: A Perfect Blend of Rustic Beauty and Function

We’re excited to present the Big Bertha Cabin, one of our most versatile and customizable floor plans. This stunning cabin offers two distinct layouts to suit your needs.

  1. 14 ft by 42 ft Design:

    • Total Living Space: 945 sq. ft
    • Porch: 6 ft by 42 ft covered area
    • Bedrooms: One on the main floor, two lofted upstairs

  2. 14 ft by 32 ft Design:

    • Total Living Space: 796 sq. ft
    • Porch: 6 ft by 32 ft covered area
    • Bedrooms: Two lofted upstairs, no bedrooms downstairs in the most popular design
    • Customizations: Layouts can always be modified to meet your preferences

Upgrade Options:
For added flexibility, you can upgrade the Big Bertha Cabin to include 1.5 or 2 bathrooms for an additional fee.

Construction & Insulation:

  • Walls: Constructed from treated Southern Yellow Pine, 4 in x 6 in solid timber, providing robust durability.
  • Insulation: Standard R19 insulation in the ceiling, with optional upgrades to R30 for colder climates like Colorado (additional fee applies).
  • Chinking: We use Log Jam (Perma-Chink) to seal the timber, accommodating wood expansion and contraction through the seasons for optimal efficiency.

Material Upgrades:

  • Cedar: Upgrade to a fully cedar cabin for a 25% upcharge.
  • Eastern White Pine: Upgrade to Eastern White Pine for a 20% upcharge.

Transport & Setup:

  • Hinge System: The cabin’s porch and roof feature a hinge system for easy transportation. Upon delivery, both the porch and roof will need to be reassembled on-site, a process that typically takes 1 to 2 full days.
  • Shipping & Setup Fees: The base model pricing includes shipping and setup. Please note that prices for appliances, heating, cooling, and electric packages are separate.

Foundations:
If you would like your cabin installed on a block crawlspace or basement foundation, you will need to pay for and arrange a crane to hoist the cabin onto the foundation. Additionally, there will be extra setup fees for our team to remain on-site during this assembly process.

Additional Features:

  • Electrical Package: 200 amp or 100 amp options available for $10,000.
  • Plumbing Package: Includes installation of tubs, toilets, sinks, and rough plumbing for $10,000.
  • Heating & Cooling: Mini-split systems available upon request for an additional fee.
  • Foundation: Requires a 6-inch slab with rebar; slab length and width dimensions will be determined for you based on what size cabin you purchase from us. Alternatively, save on costs with 2-foot runners placed 10 feet off-center to match the cabin’s wooden runners.

Roof & Windows:

  • Roof: Made from 26-gauge metal with a choice of 12 colors; matching shutters are available. You can pick any color roof you want.
  • Windows: Double-pane with Argon gas, designed for easy cleaning and all-season durability.

Interior Features:

  • Kitchen Cabinets: Handcrafted Amish-built cabinets included.
  • Porch Swing: One swing included; additional swings available for $375 each.

Customizations:

  • Floor Plans: Modifications can be made at no additional cost within reason.
  • Back Porch Add-On: Full back porch for $10,000 or half back porch for $7,500.

Ordering & Financing:

  • Lead Time: Current lead time is approximately 4.5 to 5 months due to high demand.
  • Land Prep: Requires a 6-inch slab with rebar; options available for cost-saving solutions.
  • Layaway-to-Own: Lock in your cabin price with just 10% down. Check out our "Layaway-To-Own" section on the website for details.

For any questions or to place your order, call us at 502-298-8946 or use the "Contact Us" form on our website. We’re here to help you every step of the way!

Note: Our cabins are modular pre-built structures, not kits. However, if you prefer a DIY approach, we offer a kit version of this model. Pricing for the kit includes shipping but does not cover setup. For more details, please see the pricing information below.

Thank you for considering Amish Built Cabins. We look forward to helping you create your perfect retreat!

name: El Chapo Muchacho 1.0 Amish Built Modular Cabin
title: El Chapo Muchacho 1.0 Amish Built Modular Cabin
description:
The El Chapo Muchacho Rustic Amish-Built Cabin

The El Chapo Muchacho is one of our best-selling ranch-style, one-story cabins, offering versatile layouts and rustic charm. Whether you're looking for a cozy 1-bedroom, 1-bathroom model or a spacious 3-bedroom, 2-bathroom home, this cabin has options to suit your needs. 

Cabin Customization Options:

  • Purchase as a Shell: Perfect for DIY enthusiasts who want to finish the interior themselves.
  • Turnkey Upgrades: Let us handle the finishing touches, including:
    • Electric: $10,000
    • Plumbing: $10,000
    • Heating and Cooling: $8,000 to $12,000 (cost varies by cabin size)

Build Timeline:

Due to high demand, current turnaround times for builds are 5 to 6 months.

Shipping and Setup:

  • Shipping Cost: Approx. $10,000 to most parts of the United States (note: not all areas are serviceable).
  • Includes shipping, permits, and reassembly of the porch system, which must be folded for transport.
  • Setup on-site includes placing the cabin on a foundation or blocks.

Foundation Options:

  • Concrete Slab: Most customers opt for a 6-inch concrete slab with rebar. Cabins are set 3 feet off the slab on blocks for easy crawlspace access.
  • Basement: Requires an on-site crane at the customer’s expense.

Materials and Upgrades:

  • Walls: 4x6 solid Southern Yellow Pine, with an option to upgrade to Redwood Cedar for 25% more.
  • Roof: Durable 26-gauge metal.
  • Insulation: Closed-cell spray foam is recommended for the subfloor after plumbing is connected.

The El Chapo Muchacho Cabin is built for durability, beauty, and functionality, making it an ideal choice for families, weekend retreats, or rental properties.

Ready to Order?

Call us today at 502-298-8946 for pricing, questions, or to place your order. Let us help you create your perfect cabin!

name: The Smoky Mountain Cabin Series (INDIANA PRICING)
title: The Smoky Mountain Cabin Series (INDIANA PRICING)
description:
The Smoky Mountain Series combines the comfort of a full-sized home with the practicality of a compact design. These spacious cabins are available in versatile 1- or 2-bedroom floor plans with 1 or 2 bathrooms, ranging from 532 to 832 sq. ft.

As one of our best sellers across our many factories, this series offers a wide range of customizable options to suit your style. Choose from classic rustic features or sleek modern upgrades to create the perfect cabin for your needs. Exterior options include durable Hardie board siding or upgraded cedar log siding, while interior finishes range from nickel gap walls to pine paneling, allowing you to personalize every detail.

Whether you're dreaming of a cozy rustic retreat or a contemporary getaway, the Smoky Mountain Cabin Series delivers exceptional versatility and charm in a smart-sized package.

Standard Pricing Options Included:
Exterior: Louisiana Pacific SmartBoard Siding with Haley

Exterior Paint coating
Wall and Ceiling Finish: Ponderosa Pine walls and ceiling with clear coat finish

Flooring: Mohawk Laminate waterproof flooring

Cabinets: Alder or Painted

Insulation: To building code, fiberglass insulation in walls and ceiling

Subfloor Insulation: Closed Cell Sprayfoam

Mechanical: On Demand Electric Water heater, Electrical panel sized for load usage

HVAC: Mini Split Prep if needed

The Smoky Mountain Series combines the comfort of a full-sized home with the practicality of a compact design. These spacious cabins are available in versatile 1- or 2-bedroom floor plans with 1 or 2 bathrooms, ranging from 532 to 832 sq. ft.

As one of our best sellers across our many factories, this series offers a wide range of customizable options to suit your style. Choose from classic rustic features or sleek modern upgrades to create the perfect cabin for your needs. Exterior options include durable Hardie board siding or upgraded cedar log siding, while interior finishes range from nickel gap walls to pine paneling, allowing you to personalize every detail.

Whether you're dreaming of a cozy rustic retreat or a contemporary getaway, the Smoky Mountain Cabin Series delivers exceptional versatility and charm in a smart-sized package.

Upgrade Options:
For added flexibility, you can upgrade the Big Bertha Cabin to include 1.5 or 2 bathrooms for an additional fee.

Construction & Insulation:

  • Walls: Constructed from treated Southern Yellow Pine, 4 in x 6 in solid timber, providing robust durability.
  • Insulation: Standard R19 insulation in the ceiling, with optional upgrades to R30 for colder climates like Colorado (additional fee applies).
  • Chinking: We use Log Jam (Perma-Chink) to seal the timber, accommodating wood expansion and contraction through the seasons for optimal efficiency.

Material Upgrades:

  • Cedar: Upgrade to a fully cedar cabin for a 25% upcharge.
  • Eastern White Pine: Upgrade to Eastern White Pine for a 20% upcharge.

Transport & Setup:

  • Hinge System: The cabin’s porch and roof feature a hinge system for easy transportation. Upon delivery, both the porch and roof will need to be reassembled on-site, a process that typically takes 1 to 2 full days.

Foundations:
If you would like your cabin installed on a block crawlspace or basement foundation, you will need to pay for and arrange a crane to hoist the cabin onto the foundation. Additionally, there will be extra setup fees for our team to remain on-site during this assembly process.

Additional Features:

  • Electrical Package: 200 amp or 100 amp options available for $10,000.
  • Plumbing Package: Includes installation of tubs, toilets, sinks, and rough plumbing for $10,000.
  • Heating & Cooling: Mini-split systems available upon request for an additional fee.
  • Foundation: Requires a 6-inch slab with rebar; slab length and width dimensions will be determined for you based on what size cabin you purchase from us. Alternatively, save on costs with 2-foot runners placed 10 feet off-center to match the cabin’s wooden runners.

Roof & Windows:

  • Roof: Made from 26-gauge metal with a choice of 12 colors; matching shutters are available. You can pick any color roof you want.
  • Windows: Double-pane with Argon gas, designed for easy cleaning and all-season durability.

Interior Features:

  • Kitchen Cabinets: Handcrafted Amish-built cabinets included.
  • Porch Swing: One swing included; additional swings available for $375 each.

Customizations:

  • Floor Plans: Modifications can be made at no additional cost within reason.
  • Back Porch Add-On: Full back porch for $10,000 or half back porch for $7,500.

Ordering & Financing:

  • Lead Time: Current lead time is approximately 4.5 to 5 months due to high demand.
  • Land Prep: Requires a 6-inch slab with rebar; options available for cost-saving solutions.
  • Layaway-to-Own: Lock in your cabin price with just 10% down. Check out our "Layaway-To-Own" section on the website for details.

For any questions or to place your order, call us at 502-298-8946 or use the "Contact Us" form on our website. We’re here to help you every step of the way!

Note: Our cabins are modular pre-built structures, not kits. However, if you prefer a DIY approach, we offer a kit version of this model. Pricing for the kit includes shipping but does not cover setup. For more details, please see the pricing information below.

Thank you for considering Amish Built Cabins. We look forward to helping you create your perfect retreat!

description:
The Gatlinburg Series

Big Cabin Living. Amish Craftsmanship. Built to Make a Statement.

The Gatlinburg Series was designed for buyers who want the warmth and character of a mountain cabin with the space, comfort, and finishes of a modern home.

Available in two sizes — the Gatlinburg Jr. and the larger Gatlinburg Sr. — both models feature spacious open-concept living, two main-floor bedrooms, two full bathrooms, a large upstairs loft, premium Amish-crafted cabinetry, metal roofing and siding, and an oversized covered front porch.

Whether you choose the Jr. or the Sr., the Gatlinburg Series gives you a home that feels substantial, comfortable, and built for real everyday living.

Choose Your Gatlinburg

The Gatlinburg Jr.

Starting At: $284,900

  • Building Size: 28' x 44'

  • Main-Floor Footprint: 1,232 sq. ft.

  • Loft: Approximately 21' x 23' — 483 sq. ft.

  • Approximate Main Floor + Loft Space: 1,715 sq. ft.

  • Bedrooms: 2

  • Bathrooms: 2

  • Covered Front Porch: 6' x 40'

  • Ships Throughout the United States

The Gatlinburg Jr. packs a surprising amount of living space into a beautifully designed 28' x 44' footprint.

The main floor features two bedrooms, two full bathrooms, and a large open kitchen and living area.

Above the main living space is a huge open loft measuring approximately 21' x 23', giving you roughly 483 additional square feet of flexible space.

Use the loft as a bunk room, game room, home office, media room, kids' space, additional sleeping area, or private retreat.

Out front, the large 6' x 40' covered porch gives the Gatlinburg Jr. its unmistakable mountain-home look while adding a generous outdoor living area.

The Gatlinburg Sr.

Starting At: $299,900

  • Building Size: 28' x 52'

  • Main-Floor Footprint: 1,456 sq. ft.

  • Loft: Approximately 21' x 31' — 651 sq. ft.

  • Approximate Main Floor + Loft Space: 2,107 sq. ft.

  • Bedrooms: 2

  • Bathrooms: 2

  • Covered Front Porch: 6' x 52'

  • Ships Throughout the United States

The Gatlinburg Sr. takes everything people love about the Jr. and makes it bigger.

With a 28' x 52' main-floor footprint, the Senior provides approximately 1,456 square feet on the first floor along with a massive loft measuring approximately 21' x 31'.

That gives the Gatlinburg Sr. more than 2,100 square feet of combined main-floor and loft space.

The Senior also features an incredible 6' x 52' covered front porch running nearly the full length of the home.

It's the perfect place for rocking chairs, outdoor dining, porch swings, entertaining, or simply enjoying the view.

Gatlinburg Jr. vs. Gatlinburg Sr.

Built With Quality in Mind

We believe the materials behind the walls matter just as much as what you see on the outside.

The Gatlinburg Series combines traditional Amish craftsmanship with carefully selected building materials designed for strength, comfort, durability, and long-term performance.

Custom Amish-Made Cabinetry

Each Gatlinburg home features locally crafted Amish-made cabinetry built specifically for the home.

Standard cabinetry includes:

  • Flat-panel plywood cabinet doors

  • Soft-close door hinges

  • Soft-close drawer slides

  • Custom cabinet layouts based on the approved design

  • Customer-selected cabinet colors

  • Matte-black cabinet hardware

Premium Entry Doors

Quality ProVia entry doors provide durability, security, energy efficiency, and a polished finished appearance.

Standard entry doors include matte-black hardware and deadbolts.

The Gatlinburg Series features black Andersen 100 Series double-pane windows, providing dependable performance, a modern appearance, and plenty of natural light.

Metal Roofing & Siding

Standard Gatlinburg models include locally sourced Premier metal roofing and siding for a durable, low-maintenance exterior.

Customers can select from available colors to create anything from a modern black cabin to a classic mountain or farmhouse look.

  • ¾" OSB subfloor

The Gatlinburg Series is designed as modular residential construction built to applicable International Residential Code standards.

description:
The Cumberland Crossing Cabin by Amish Built Cabins

The Cumberland Crossing Cabin is a beautifully crafted certified modular cabin, built with meticulous Amish craftsmanship in our Amish factory. Designed to maximize space and create a unique footprint, this two-part cabin connects on-site end-to-side, offering a fresh take on traditional cabin design. Perfect for families, vacation homes, or rental properties, The Cumberland Crossing blends modern versatility with rustic elegance.

Features & Customization Options:

  • Versatile Floor Plans: Offered in four layouts, configurable with 2 to 3 bedrooms and 2 to 3 bathrooms, ranging from 992 to 1,504 square feet to fit your lifestyle.
  • Innovative Design: The two-part structure connects on your site, maximizing your property space and offering a unique layout that sets it apart from one-piece prefab cabins.
  • Modern Interiors: Open living spaces, customizable kitchens, and flexible configurations to meet your specific needs.
  • Rustic Charm or Contemporary Style: Choose from classic wood finishes or sleek, modern upgrades to make your cabin truly yours.
  • Energy Efficiency: Comes standard with high-quality insulation, ensuring year-round comfort and energy savings.

Customization Highlights:

  • Exterior Options: Choose from standard vinyl siding, rustic cedar log siding, board and batten, or durable Hardie board for a tailored look.
  • Interior Finishes: Personalize with nickel gap walls, tongue-and-groove pine paneling, or drywall for a clean, modern aesthetic.
  • Outdoor Living: Expand your space with optional wrap-around decks for scenic views and outdoor enjoyment.

Built to Code for All 50 States

The Cumberland Crossing is built to meet building codes nationwide, including wind, snow, and insulation requirements, offering peace of mind wherever you are.

Warranty & Quality Guarantee:

We stand behind The Cumberland Crossing with a 10-year structural warranty, showcasing our commitment to quality and durability.

description:
The Cumberland Crossing Cabin by Amish Built Cabins

The Cumberland Crossing Cabin is a beautifully crafted certified modular cabin, built with meticulous Amish craftsmanship in our Amish factory. Designed to maximize space and create a unique footprint, this two-part cabin connects on-site end-to-side, offering a fresh take on traditional cabin design. Perfect for families, vacation homes, or rental properties, The Cumberland Crossing blends modern versatility with rustic elegance.

Features & Customization Options:

  • Versatile Floor Plans: Offered in four layouts, configurable with 2 to 3 bedrooms and 2 to 3 bathrooms, ranging from 992 to 1,504 square feet to fit your lifestyle.
  • Innovative Design: The two-part structure connects on your site, maximizing your property space and offering a unique layout that sets it apart from one-piece prefab cabins.
  • Modern Interiors: Open living spaces, customizable kitchens, and flexible configurations to meet your specific needs.
  • Rustic Charm or Contemporary Style: Choose from classic wood finishes or sleek, modern upgrades to make your cabin truly yours.
  • Energy Efficiency: Comes standard with high-quality insulation, ensuring year-round comfort and energy savings.

Customization Highlights:

  • Exterior Options: Choose from standard vinyl siding, rustic cedar log siding, board and batten, or durable Hardie board for a tailored look.
  • Interior Finishes: Personalize with nickel gap walls, tongue-and-groove pine paneling, or drywall for a clean, modern aesthetic.
  • Outdoor Living: Expand your space with optional wrap-around decks for scenic views and outdoor enjoyment.

Built to Code for All 50 States

The Cumberland Crossing is built to meet building codes nationwide, including wind, snow, and insulation requirements, offering peace of mind wherever you are.

Warranty & Quality Guarantee:

We stand behind The Cumberland Crossing with a 10-year structural warranty, showcasing our commitment to quality and durability.

The Cumberland Crossing Cabin by Amish Built Cabins

The Cumberland Crossing Cabin is a beautifully crafted certified modular cabin, built with meticulous Amish craftsmanship in our Amish factory. Designed to maximize space and create a unique footprint, this two-part cabin connects on-site end-to-side, offering a fresh take on traditional cabin design. Perfect for families, vacation homes, or rental properties, The Cumberland Crossing blends modern versatility with rustic elegance.

Features & Customization Options:

  • Versatile Floor Plans: Offered in four layouts, configurable with 2 to 3 bedrooms and 2 to 3 bathrooms, ranging from 992 to 1,504 square feet to fit your lifestyle.
  • Innovative Design: The two-part structure connects on your site, maximizing your property space and offering a unique layout that sets it apart from one-piece prefab cabins.
  • Modern Interiors: Open living spaces, customizable kitchens, and flexible configurations to meet your specific needs.
  • Rustic Charm or Contemporary Style: Choose from classic wood finishes or sleek, modern upgrades to make your cabin truly yours.
  • Energy Efficiency: Comes standard with high-quality insulation, ensuring year-round comfort and energy savings.

Customization Highlights:

  • Exterior Options: Choose from standard vinyl siding, rustic cedar log siding, board and batten, or durable Hardie board for a tailored look.
  • Interior Finishes: Personalize with nickel gap walls, tongue-and-groove pine paneling, or drywall for a clean, modern aesthetic.
  • Outdoor Living: Expand your space with optional wrap-around decks for scenic views and outdoor enjoyment.

Built to Code for All 50 States

The Cumberland Crossing is built to meet building codes nationwide, including wind, snow, and insulation requirements, offering peace of mind wherever you are.

Warranty & Quality Guarantee:

We stand behind The Cumberland Crossing with a 10-year structural warranty, showcasing our commitment to quality and durability.

Current Lead Time:

Due to high demand, current build time is approximately 18–22 weeks.

Get Pricing & More Information:

To explore state-specific pricing or customize your dream cabin, call us today at 502-298-8946 or fill out our contact form online. The Cumberland Crossing Cabin offers the perfect balance of innovation, comfort, and timeless charm—your ideal retreat or forever home awaits!

These homes go up significantly faster—cutting labor costs by up to 60% thanks to their pre-engineered, easy-to-assemble design. They're also much lower maintenance, since they're built like conventional homes but finished with durable D-log siding to give you the authentic log home look—without the ongoing upkeep real log homes require. That means more time enjoying your home and less time maintaining it. Plus, panelized log homes and panelized log cabins are far more energy-efficient, with high-performance SIPs (structural insulated panels) used in the exterior walls to keep energy bills low and comfort high year-round.

name: HOW OUR STEEL HOUSE KITS WORK
title: HOW OUR STEEL HOUSE KITS WORK
description:
Here’s a quick overview of how our process and product works:

Pricing

Our steel-framed home kits are priced as follows:

  • $75 per sq ft for a self-install shell kit

  • $135 per sq ft for the kit plus our team installing the shell on your foundation

Both pricing options include shipping of the kit as well as applicable taxes, so there are no surprises on the material side.

Construction & Materials

We build using the ZIP System panel, a very popular and high-quality building method. Unlike traditional house wrap like Tyvek, ZIP panels combine structural sheathing with a built-in weather-resistant barrier—resulting in fewer seams, faster installation, and long-term protection against moisture and air leaks.

Our structures are built with 16 to 18 gauge steel framing, depending on your local building code requirements.

Engineering & Flexibility

Whether you choose the self-install option or our install package, we provide engineered plans and drawings that your contractor can use for foundation work and that can be submitted to your county for permitting and code compliance.

One major advantage of building with steel is flexibility—you are not limited to our designs. If you have a floor plan or home style you love, send it over and we can replicate it using our steel system so you get exactly what you want.

Windows & Doors

Due to customers wanting specific brands and styles, we no longer include windows and doors in our kits.

However, if you purchase them separately and have them on-site, we will install them at no additional cost as part of the $135 per sq ft package—helping get your home fully dried-in.

What You Get

Once we complete our portion, your home will be a fully framed and sealed “dried-in shell” using ZIP panels on both the walls and roof.

Interior rooms will also be framed out using steel studs, so you will have a full layout of your home completed and ready for the next phase.

At the stage we leave, your home is:

  • Fully dried-in

  • Protected from the elements

  • Structurally complete and framed

  • Ready for your next crews

(Please see the attached photo for an example of what your home will look like at this stage—it will appear green from the ZIP system.)

What We Do NOT Include

To be clear:

  • We only install the dried-in shell

  • We do not handle electrical or plumbing

  • We do not install drywall or interior finishes

Electrical and plumbing must be completed by licensed professionals in your state.

Insulation, drywall, siding, roofing finish, and all interior/exterior finishes are completed by you and your contractors after we are done.

Size Range

We can build steel-framed homes ranging from as small as 400 sq ft all the way up to 12,000 sq ft and everything in between.

Our most popular sizes tend to be:

  • 800 sq ft

  • 1,200 sq ft

  • 2,400 sq ft

But we are fully equipped to handle projects well beyond that range depending on your needs.

Getting Started

If you’d like to move forward, we offer the option to secure your project with a 10% deposit to lock in your pricing—especially with steel prices continuing to fluctuate.

Thanks again for considering us—we’d love the opportunity to help you build your home.

Thank you,
Nadia
AmishBuiltCabins.com
